sentences.text: GM1 gangliosidosis type 1 and mucopolysaccharidosis type 4B are both linked to the gene GLB1 in curated databases [e_182f5f2e300f] [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
Constellate computed that they share this causal gene, with confidence 0.95, the lowest of the two gene links [e_569aeea83be4].
For GM1 gangliosidosis type 1, a raised level of certain sugar fragments in urine is a curated, very frequent feature [e_3b928c309c9f].
A dark area in the basal ganglia, a deep brain region, on one type of scan is listed as frequent, with a lower confidence of 0.6 [e_519a07ba95a9].
This shows that one gene can sit behind two conditions that are named very differently [e_569aeea83be4].
These edges list no symptoms for mucopolysaccharidosis type 4B [e_ebcdbdec8f81].
They also show no studies, funding or patient groups for either condition [e_182f5f2e300f].
